description: This file defines the SparseBitVector class and its associated element class, implementing a sparse bitvector data structure optimized for efficient storage and operations on sparse sets of bits. It includes methods for setting, resetting, testing bits, and performing set operations like union, intersection, and difference.

classes.name: SparseBitVectorElement
classes.description: Represents an element of the sparse bitvector, storing a fixed-size array of bits and providing methods for bit manipulation and querying.

classes.name: SparseBitVector
classes.description: Implements a sparse bitvector using a linked list of SparseBitVectorElements, supporting efficient set operations and bit queries.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Checks if a specific bit is set.

methods.name: test_and_set
methods.description: Tests and sets a specific bit atomically.

methods.name: operator|=
methods.description: Performs in-place union with another SparseBitVector.

methods.name: operator&=
methods.description: Performs in-place intersection with another SparseBitVector.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Performs in-place difference (set subtraction) with another SparseBitVector.

methods.name: intersectWithComplement
methods.description: Performs intersection with the complement of another SparseBitVector.
